issue_request: FHIR-20205 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for R5 asking that the CodeSystem $lookup OperationDefinition support instance-level invocation and that the operation page include the corresponding [base]/CodeSystem/[id]/$lookup form. The Jira resolution text contains a copied "$expand" typo, but the issue summary, description, linked discussion, and target artifact are consistently CodeSystem $lookup.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20205 was found for the CodeSystem $lookup source. The effective application appears in git history as d46f7ac45d5828ca61f2b9c818768f2fde04b4af, which changed source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-lookup.xml from instance=false to instance=true under the broader FHIR-27761 multi-level operation tooling work.
additional_context: The current build-scope source has CodeSystem active in source/fhir.ini, lists OperationDefinition/CodeSystem-lookup in source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml, and the authoritative OperationDefinition now has resource=CodeSystem, type=true, and instance=true. The terminology service narrative also includes an instance-level example, GET [base]/CodeSystem/loinc/$lookup?code=1963-8. The original Zulip thread confirms the requested change was considered an oversight and compatible; Vocabulary minutes on 2022-04-04 record FHIR-20205 as resolved change required.
reconciliation: No source change was made because editing the OperationDefinition or adding redundant narrative would not change implementer understanding: the current authoritative operation definition already enables instance invocation and the current terminology-service source already demonstrates the instance URL form.
